qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Pan-Nordic oligopoly scale and sector-leading cost efficiency (cost-to-income ~45%) provide low-cost funding and pricing power; proven by sustained 15-17% ROE and strong capital generation across Nordic markets.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Balance Sheet, REJECT). Premier pan-Nordic banking oligopolist with best-in-class cost efficiency (cost-to-income ~45%), strong capital generation (15-17% ROE), and disciplined buybacks. However, as a commercial fractional-reserve bank operating with ~17x balance sheet leverage on tangible equity and massive wholesale debt funding (€200B+), it fails the Munger peace-of-mind balance sheet standard.
qualitative.evidence: Nordea delivered €4.8B-€5.0B in net income across FY2024-2025 with an elite European banking ROE of 15.5%-16.7% and a CET1 ratio of 15.7%. However, its balance sheet carries €206.6B in long-term debt and over €550B in total liabilities against €32.4B in equity (17x leverage). Inherent reliance on covered bond wholesale markets and fractional-reserve deposit duration mismatch disqualifies it under Gate 6 commercial bank rules.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
